calibration.tiles_weight_model: tiles_gb = pbf_gb x [0.8 .. 1.9] — Spain calibration (1.3 GB pbf -> 1-2.5 GB tiles, bake §L-607), which was FOUR layers; the pipeline now bakes SEVEN, so lean to the upper half. Re-measure on the LU+EE calibration bakes before finalising the R2 budget.
calibration.time_model: PROJECTED, not measured: run 30706761446 (buildings layer only, 24 regions, ~13.6 GB pbf est.) hit the 180-min timeout at 99.9% => ~13 min/GB for the buildings chain; full 7-layer bake projected ~15-25 min per GB of pbf + ~2-4 min fixed per country (download+clip). The LU and EE CI bakes are the designated re-calibration points — replace this model with their measured wall-clocks.

prerequisites_before_any_publish: R2 budget decision (founder): scope tiles projected 24-57 GB vs the 10 GB free tier bake §L-607 states — paid R2 ~$0.36-0.86/mo, or trim maxzoom/layers for mass-only countries, or stage countries.

Workflow switch (HARD prerequisite, arithmetically forced now): ALL_REGIONS is ~33 GB of pbf across 35 regions; the buildings layer ALONE hit 180 min on the old ~13.6 GB set and the job ceiling is 330 min (GitHub max 360). An unscoped full bake CANNOT finish. Switch context-bake.yml to per-region bakes + merged artifacts/incremental `aws s3 sync` exactly as bake.mjs:57 designs. Until it lands, the §BAKE-BY-REGION warning binds: a region-scoped publish REPLACES the whole tileset.
